description: We are AEVION, a team from Jazan building a digital dashboard that gives astronauts a clear picture of their health in one view. It compares wristband data with each astronaut's own baseline, shows a status with a reason and next step, and works without contact with Earth. Our team covers research, UI/UX, presentation and programming. We welcome members skilled in space or health science, data analysis, or wearables.
